sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是《Casefile Presents》推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode involves a crime against children.
sentences.zh: 本集涉及针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It may not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 可能不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: There was excitement in the air as Marion Sodder returned home following her shift at the local dollar store on Christmas Eve 1945.
sentences.zh: 1945年平安夜，玛丽昂·索德结束了在当地一元店的轮班回到家中，空气中弥漫着节日的兴奋气息。

sentences.en: Seventeen-year-old Marion handed out gifts she had bought from work to her younger siblings, who persuaded their parents, George and Jenny, to let them open a few early.
sentences.zh: 17岁的玛丽昂把从店里买的礼物分发给弟弟妹妹们，孩子们说服了父母乔治和珍妮，让他们提前拆开几份礼物。

sentences.en: The family of twelve had an extra reason to celebrate Christmas that year.
sentences.zh: 这一年，这个十二口之家有一个额外的理由来庆祝圣诞节。

sentences.en: World War II had ended only three months prior.
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战才刚刚结束三个月。

sentences.en: It wouldn't be long before the Sodder's second oldest son, Joseph, who had been serving in the US Army, returned home to Fayetteville, West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 索德家二儿子约瑟夫一直在美国陆军服役，很快就要回到西弗吉尼亚州的费耶特维尔家中了。

sentences.en: As the night wore on, two of the older Sodder sons, John and George Jr., retired to bed.
sentences.zh: 夜色渐深，索德家两个较大的儿子约翰和小乔治上床休息了。

sentences.en: They had spent the day helping their father with work and were tired.
sentences.zh: 他们白天一直在帮父亲干活，已经很累了。

sentences.en: The pair headed up into the attic, which was used as a space for the many Sodder children to sleep.
sentences.zh: 两人上到了阁楼，那里是索德家许多孩子睡觉的地方。

sentences.en: The attic was divided into two rooms and accessible via a set of stairs.
sentences.zh: 阁楼被隔成了两个房间，通过楼梯可以上去。

sentences.en: George Sr.
sentences.zh: 老乔治

sentences.en: also went to bed at this time, in the master bedroom on the main floor.
sentences.zh: 此时也上床休息了，睡在主楼层的主卧里。

sentences.en: His wife followed shortly thereafter at around 10.30pm, taking their three-year-old daughter, Sylvia, with her.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子珍妮不久后也于晚上10点半左右上床，并带上了他们三岁的女儿西尔维娅。

sentences.en: The other Sodder children, Morris, Martha, Lewis, Jenny and Betty, continued to play with their new toys.
sentences.zh: 索德家的其他孩子——莫里斯、玛莎、刘易斯、珍妮和贝蒂——继续玩着他们的新玩具。

sentences.en: Marion lay on the couch, keeping an eye on the youngsters, who ranged from five to fourteen years old.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂躺在沙发上，照看着这些年龄在5岁到14岁之间的弟弟妹妹们。

sentences.en: At about 12.30am, Jenny woke to the sound of the telephone ringing in her husband's study next to the master bedroom.
sentences.zh: 凌晨12点半左右，珍妮被主卧隔壁丈夫书房里的电话铃声吵醒了。

sentences.en: She got up to answer it and was met on the line by a woman whose voice she didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 她起身去接电话，电话那头是一个她从未听过的女人的声音。

sentences.en: In the background were the sounds of laughing and chatter and of glass clinking.
sentences.zh: 背景里传来笑声、谈话声和玻璃杯碰撞的声音。

sentences.en: The caller asked for someone who didn't reside at the Sodder residence.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人要找一个不住在索德家的人。

sentences.en: When Jenny told her she had the wrong number, the woman laughed, strangely, before hanging up.
sentences.zh: 当珍妮告诉她打错电话时，那个女人发出了一阵奇怪的笑声，然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: As she left the study, Jenny realised the lights were still on in the family room where the children had been playing.
sentences.zh: 离开书房时，珍妮发现孩子们玩耍的家庭活动室里灯还亮着。

sentences.en: The front door was also unlocked.
sentences.zh: 前门也没锁。

sentences.en: Usually the job of the last family member to go to bed, Jenny walked past Marion, who was sleeping on the sofa, and locked the door and turned off the lights.
sentences.zh: 通常这是最后一个上床的家人的工作，珍妮走过睡在沙发上的玛丽昂，锁上了门并关掉了灯。

sentences.en: Assuming all her other children were asleep in the attic, Jenny went back to bed.
sentences.zh: 以为其他孩子都在阁楼里睡着了，珍妮便回房睡觉了。

sentences.en: A light sleeper, Jenny was disrupted again 30 minutes later at around 1am on Christmas morning.
sentences.zh: 珍妮睡眠很浅，30分钟后，也就是圣诞节凌晨1点左右，她再次被惊醒。

sentences.en: What sounded like a hard rubber ball landed on the tar and wood roof of the family's cottage.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一个硬橡胶球落在了家里小屋的焦油和木质屋顶上。

sentences.en: It rolled down the roof.
sentences.zh: 它顺着屋顶滚了下去。

sentences.en: Then there was silence.
sentences.zh: 随后是一片寂静。

sentences.en: Exhausted, Jenny ignored the noise, rolling over and going back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 精疲力竭的珍妮忽略了这阵响声，翻了个身继续睡觉。

sentences.en: 30 minutes later, at 1.30am, Jenny woke to the smell of smoke.
sentences.zh: 30分钟后，凌晨1点半，珍妮被烟味熏醒了。

sentences.en: She followed the trail and found it was coming from George's study, which was on fire.
sentences.zh: 她顺着烟味找去，发现火是从乔治的书房冒出来的，那里已经着火了。

sentences.en: She raced back to her room and roused George.
sentences.zh: 她冲回房间叫醒了乔治。

sentences.en: He in turn woke Marion, who was still sleeping on the sofa.
sentences.zh: 乔治随即叫醒了还在沙发上睡觉的玛丽昂。

sentences.en: She took three-year-old Sylvia outside to safety.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂带着三岁的西尔维娅跑到了外面安全的地方。

sentences.en: Jenny yelled frantically at the bottom of the attic stairs for the seven children above to come down.
sentences.zh: 珍妮在阁楼楼梯底部疯狂地大喊，让楼上的七个孩子快下来。

sentences.en: The fire was moving quickly and was already starting to take hold of the stairs.
sentences.zh: 火势蔓延得很快，已经开始吞噬楼梯了。

sentences.en: After what seemed an eternity, John and George Jr.
sentences.zh: 在经历了漫长得仿佛永恒的等待后，约翰和小乔治

sentences.en: made their way down.
sentences.zh: 跑了下来。

sentences.en: Their hair was singed from the flames.
sentences.zh: 他们的头发都被火焰烧焦了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, George Sr.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，老乔治

sentences.en: attempted to call the local fire department, only to find the phone line to the sodder house was dead.
sentences.zh: 试图给当地消防局打电话，却发现通往索德家的电话线断了。

sentences.en: Marion sprinted to their closest neighbour, who also tried to call, but the phone went unanswered by the operator.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂跑向最近的邻居，邻居也试图打电话，但接线员一直没有回应。

sentences.en: Another neighbour, who was still awake, saw the sodder house going up in flames and also attempted to phone the fire department.
sentences.zh: 另一位还没睡的邻居看到了索德家火光冲天，也试图给消防局打电话。

sentences.en: But again, there was no operator response.
sentences.zh: 但同样，接线员没有任何回应。

sentences.en: George Sr.
sentences.zh: 老乔治

sentences.en: was forced to retreat from the house when the flames and smoke became too intense.
sentences.zh: 在火焰和浓烟变得过于猛烈时，被迫撤离了房子。

sentences.en: Four of his children and his wife were safe outside in the freezing winter night.
sentences.zh: 他的四个孩子和妻子在寒冷的冬夜里安全地待在外面。

sentences.en: But his five children, who had been up late playing with their toys, remained in the attic.
sentences.zh: 但他那五个刚才还在熬夜玩玩具的孩子，依然留在阁楼里。

sentences.en: Attempts to control the fire with water from the outside rain barrel proved fruitless.
sentences.zh: 试图用外面的雨水桶里的水来控制火势，结果徒劳无功。

sentences.en: It was frozen solid.
sentences.zh: 水桶里的水已经冻成了冰块。

sentences.en: Instead, George Sr.
sentences.zh: 于是，老乔治

sentences.en: realised he might be able to climb up to the exterior attic window.
sentences.zh: 意识到他或许可以爬到阁楼外面的窗户那里。

sentences.en: He ran around to the side of the house where he always kept his trusty ladder.
sentences.zh: 他跑到房子侧面，那里一直放着他那把可靠的梯子。

sentences.en: It was gone.
sentences.zh: 梯子不见了。

sentences.en: George had another idea.
sentences.zh: 乔治又想到了一个办法。

sentences.en: He jumped into one of his two coal trucks, thinking he could reverse it up to the house and climb on top to reach the attic window.
sentences.zh: 他跳进两辆运煤卡车中的一辆，想着可以把它倒车开到房子边上，爬到车顶去够阁楼的窗户。

sentences.en: He inserted the key into the ignition, but the truck wouldn't start.
sentences.zh: 他把钥匙插进点火开关，但卡车发动不起来。

sentences.en: He tried his second coal truck.
sentences.zh: 他又试了第二辆运煤卡车。

sentences.en: It wouldn't start either.
sentences.zh: 也发动不起来。

sentences.en: Both had been working perfectly fine the previous day.
sentences.zh: 这两辆车前一天还运行得好好的。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, one of the neighbours, frustrated at not being able to reach an operator, drove into the town of Fayetteville and tracked down F.J.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一位邻居因为无法联系到接线员而感到沮丧，他开车前往费耶特维尔镇，找到了消防队长F.J.

sentences.en: Morris, the fire chief.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯。

sentences.en: He alerted his volunteer fire team using a commonplace practice at the time.
sentences.zh: 他按照当时通用的做法，通知了他的志愿消防队。

sentences.en: One fireman would call another, who would in turn call another, until a team was assembled.
sentences.zh: 一名消防员会打电话给另一名，后者再打给下一名，直到队伍集结完毕。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, many of the volunteer firefighters had yet to return from war.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，许多志愿消防员还没从战场上回来。

sentences.en: The department was severely understaffed.
sentences.zh: 消防队严重人手不足。

sentences.en: Although the fire station was just over two miles from the Sotter family home,
sentences.zh: 尽管消防站距离索德家只有两英里多一点，

sentences.en: fire chief F.J.
sentences.zh: 但消防队长F.J.

sentences.en: Morris could not attend alone, as he couldn't drive the fire truck.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯无法独自前往，因为他不会开消防车。

sentences.en: George and Jenny Sotter could do nothing more than watch the inferno helplessly.
sentences.zh: 乔治和珍妮·索德只能无助地看着大火肆虐。

sentences.en: Within 45 minutes, the roof crashed down to the basement level.
sentences.zh: 45分钟内，屋顶坍塌到了地下室。

sentences.en: Their house was completely destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他们的房子被彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: As daylight broke on Christmas Day 1945, all that was left of the Sotter house was ash and ruins.
sentences.zh: 1945年圣诞节黎明时分，索德家剩下的只有灰烬和废墟。

sentences.en: The Fayetteville Fire Department arrived at 8am, six and a half hours after the fire started, long after anything could be done to rescue the children or salvage the property.
sentences.zh: 费耶特维尔消防局在早上8点赶到，距离火灾发生已经过去了六个半小时，早已错过了营救孩子或抢救财产的最佳时机。

sentences.en: George Sotter Sr.
sentences.zh: 老乔治·索德

sentences.en: was treated at the local hospital for lacerations to his arm, sustained while trying to reach his trapped children.
sentences.zh: 在当地医院接受了治疗，他的手臂在试图营救被困孩子时受了伤。

sentences.en: Fire marshals and local police combed the wreckage for an hour.
sentences.zh: 消防督察和当地警察在废墟中搜寻了一个小时。

sentences.en: Fire chief F.J.
sentences.zh: 消防队长F.J.

sentences.en: Morris and his team failed to find any human remains, explaining to George and Jenny that their children's bones must have completely disintegrated from the heat
sentences.zh: 莫里斯和他的团队没能找到任何人类遗骸，他们向乔治和珍妮解释说，孩子们的骨头一定已经在高温

sentences.en: and intensity of the fire.
sentences.zh: 和猛烈的火势中完全化为灰烬了。

sentences.en: Newspapers throughout the United States reported on the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 美国各地的报纸都报道了这场悲剧。

sentences.en: The Fayetteville County prosecutor announced there would be an investigation into the deaths of
sentences.zh: 费耶特维尔县检察官宣布，将对以下人员的死亡展开调查：

sentences.en: 14-year-old Morris, 12-year-old Martha, 9-year-old Louis, 8-year-old Jenny and 5-year-old Betty.
sentences.zh: 14岁的莫里斯、12岁的玛莎、9岁的刘易斯、8岁的珍妮和5岁的贝蒂。

sentences.en: A coroner's jury was assembled, who concluded the cause of the fire to be faulty electrical wiring, likely originating in the home study at the rear of the house.
sentences.zh: 验尸官陪审团得出结论，火灾原因是电气线路故障，起火点很可能是在房子后部的书房。

sentences.en: Strong winds were blamed for causing the quick acceleration of the fire.
sentences.zh: 强风被认为是导致火势迅速蔓延的原因。

sentences.en: On December 30, 1945, George and Jenny Sotter were issued five death certificates for each of their deceased children.
sentences.zh: 1945年12月30日，乔治和珍妮·索德为他们去世的五个孩子每人领到了死亡证明。

sentences.en: Their cause of death was listed as, quote,
sentences.zh: 死亡原因被列为，引述：

sentences.en: Death by suffocation or fire which completely destroyed the home in which they were sleeping.
sentences.zh: 因火灾或窒息导致死亡，火灾彻底摧毁了他们睡觉的房屋。

sentences.en: As no remains had been found, the Fayetteville County prosecutor assured the Sotters a more thorough investigation would be completed in the new year,
sentences.zh: 由于没有发现遗骸，费耶特维尔县检察官向索德夫妇保证，新年过后会进行更彻底的调查，

sentences.en: once the festive season had ended.
sentences.zh: 等节日假期结束后。

sentences.en: A week later, and against the wishes of authorities, George went to work to cover the site of their former home, unable to look at the wreckage any longer.
sentences.zh: 一周后，不顾当局的意愿，乔治开始着手掩埋他们曾经的家，因为他实在无法再面对那片废墟了。

sentences.en: Using a bulldozer, George emptied five feet of dirt on top of the ashes to fill what once was the basement.
sentences.zh: 乔治用推土机在灰烬上填了五英尺厚的土，填平了曾经的地下室。

sentences.en: The Sotters then created a memorial garden and shrine at the site.
sentences.zh: 随后，索德夫妇在原址建立了一个纪念花园和神龛。

sentences.en: George built another house on his property, but in a new location.
sentences.zh: 乔治在自己的土地上又盖了一栋房子，但换了一个位置。

sentences.en: The surviving Sotters tried to move on with their lives.
sentences.zh: 幸存的索德一家试图继续他们的生活。

sentences.en: However, as the shock wore off, George and Jenny were left with an uneasy feeling.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着震惊逐渐消退，乔治和珍妮心中产生了一种不安的感觉。

sentences.en: They were certain that the fire that destroyed their house and killed their children was not an accident.
sentences.zh: 他们确信，那场摧毁了房子并夺走孩子生命的火灾绝非意外。

sentences.en: There were others in the community who felt that way too.
sentences.zh: 社区里也有其他人持同样的看法。

sentences.en: One such person was a local bus driver.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是当地的公交车司机。

sentences.en: He described what he called balls of fire being thrown by a group of people at the Sotter house.
sentences.zh: 他描述说，当时看到一群人向索德家投掷他所谓的“火球”。

sentences.en: Whether or not this lead was followed up by authorities is not known.
sentences.zh: 当局是否跟进了这条线索不得而知。

sentences.en: A few months after the blaze, the snow blanketing the region began to thaw.
sentences.zh: 火灾发生几个月后，覆盖该地区的积雪开始融化。

sentences.en: Three-year-old Sylvia was playing near the side of her former home when she found something that had previously been concealed by the snow.
sentences.zh: 三岁的西尔维娅在旧居旁玩耍时，发现了一个之前被积雪掩盖的东西。

sentences.en: About the size of a baseball and made of dark green hard rubber, the object was hollow with a screw cap.
sentences.zh: 那个物体大约棒球大小，由深绿色硬橡胶制成，是中空的，带有一个螺旋盖。

sentences.en: Sylvia showed it to her parents.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娅把它拿给父母看。

sentences.en: George thought he recognised the object and took it to a military official to confirm his belief.
sentences.zh: 乔治觉得他认得这个东西，便把它带给一位军事官员以证实他的猜想。

sentences.en: The object was a type of grenade, sometimes referred to as a pineapple bomb.
sentences.zh: 这个物体是一种手榴弹，有时被称为“菠萝弹”。

sentences.en: George was certain this was the noise Jenny heard on the roof just before the fire broke out.
sentences.zh: 乔治确信这就是火灾发生前珍妮在屋顶听到的响声。

sentences.en: He also concluded that the unknown woman who phoned the Sotter house earlier that night was calling to make sure they were home before the fire was lit.
sentences.zh: 他还推断，那天晚上早些时候给索德家打电话的那个陌生女人，是为了在点火前确认他们是否在家。

sentences.en: Adding to George and Jenny's speculation that the fire was a deliberate act was the ladder that was always kept by the side of the house.
sentences.zh: 让乔治和珍妮更加怀疑火灾是蓄意纵火的，还有那把一直放在房子侧面的梯子。

sentences.en: It was later found thrown down an embankment approximately 80 feet away, seemingly discarded by someone so it couldn't be found.
sentences.zh: 后来发现它被扔在约80英尺外的路堤下，似乎是被某人丢弃的，以免被人发现。

sentences.en: On the night of the fire, but before it was set, a man had been witnessed stealing a block and tackle from George's shed on the property.
sentences.zh: 火灾当晚，在火灾发生前，有人目击一名男子从乔治房产的棚子里偷走了一个滑轮组。

sentences.en: George used the items as a pulley system to work on his coal trucks.
sentences.zh: 乔治用这些东西作为滑轮系统来修理他的运煤卡车。

sentences.en: He speculated that his trucks might have been tampered with by the man, causing them not to work during the blaze.
sentences.zh: 他推测他的卡车可能被那个人动了手脚，导致它们在火灾期间无法启动。

sentences.en: No investigation was conducted on the trucks to see if they had been tampered with, or if it was simply the cold night air that caused them not to start.
sentences.zh: 没有人对卡车进行调查，以查看它们是否被动过手脚，或者仅仅是因为寒冷的夜间空气导致它们无法启动。

sentences.en: However, the thief, a local man named Lonnie Johnson, was later arrested and charged for the theft of the block and tackle.
sentences.zh: 然而，那个小偷，一名叫朗尼·约翰逊的当地男子，后来因盗窃滑轮组被捕并被起诉。

sentences.en: While being questioned by police, he also admitted to cutting the Sodders' electric line, despite the claims by George and Jenny Sodder,
sentences.zh: 在接受警方审讯时，他还承认切断了索德家的电线，尽管乔治和珍妮·索德声称，

sentences.en: who said the electricity was on as the house burnt down.
sentences.zh: 房子着火时电还是通的。

sentences.en: Jenny later said,
sentences.zh: 珍妮后来曾说：

sentences.en: We would never have gotten out of there alive if the lights had been cut.
sentences.zh: 如果灯被切断了，我们绝不可能活着从那里逃出来。

sentences.en: After the fire, a telephone repairman was called out to attend to a hanging telephone line.
sentences.zh: 火灾后，一名电话维修工被叫来处理一根悬垂的电话线。

sentences.en: They informed the Sodders that the phone line had been cut, explaining why George and Jenny couldn't call for the fire department during the blaze.
sentences.zh: 他们告知索德夫妇电话线确实被切断了，这解释了为什么乔治和珍妮在火灾期间无法给消防局打电话。

sentences.en: To cause this damage, someone had to climb the telegraph pole, which was over 14 feet high.
sentences.zh: 要造成这种破坏，必须有人爬上14英尺多高的电线杆。

sentences.en: The Sodders believed that Lonnie Johnson had cut the phone lines by accident, thinking it was the electric line.
sentences.zh: 索德夫妇认为朗尼·约翰逊是误把电话线当成电线给切断了。

sentences.en: Johnson pleaded guilty to cutting the line, but denied stealing the block and tackle.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊对切断线路供认不讳，但否认偷窃了滑轮组。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, he was fined $25.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是被罚款25美元。

sentences.en: Even though the Sodders were convinced their house was intentionally set alight, they were uncertain as to who might be responsible.
sentences.zh: 尽管索德夫妇确信他们的房子是被人蓄意纵火的，但他们不确定谁可能是幕后黑手。

sentences.en: As far as they were aware, their middle-class family was well-respected within their close-knit community.
sentences.zh: 据他们所知，他们这个中产阶级家庭在紧密团结的社区里一直备受尊重。

sentences.en: Both the George and Jenny were Italian immigrants who wound up in Fayetteville, where they met and fell in love.
sentences.zh: 乔治和珍妮都是意大利移民，最终在费耶特维尔定居，在那里相识并坠入爱河。

sentences.en: They had their first child, John, in 1923, before going on to have another nine children.
sentences.zh: 他们在1923年生下了第一个孩子约翰，之后又生了九个孩子。

sentences.en: George was an intelligent man, unafraid of a hard day's work.
sentences.zh: 乔治是个聪明人，不怕辛苦工作。

sentences.en: From the moment he arrived in the US at age 13, he laboured to build his own American dream.
sentences.zh: 从13岁抵达美国的那一刻起，他就努力奋斗，建立属于自己的美国梦。

sentences.en: He worked in Pennsylvania on the railway, before moving to West Virginia, where he began his own trucking business,
sentences.zh: 他曾在宾夕法尼亚州的铁路工作，后来搬到西弗吉尼亚州，在那里创办了自己的货运公司，

sentences.en: moving dirt and other construction materials around various sites.
sentences.zh: 在各个工地之间搬运泥土和其他建筑材料。

sentences.en: He settled in Fayetteville, drawn in by its large population of Italian immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他被费耶特维尔庞大的意大利移民群体所吸引，便在那里定居下来。

sentences.en: Although theirs was a happy life, the Sodder family still faced difficulties.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们的生活很幸福，但索德一家仍然面临着困难。

sentences.en: This led them to question if anyone around them might have reason to hurt them.
sentences.zh: 这让他们不禁怀疑，周围是否有人有理由伤害他们。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《Casefile》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集赞助商的内容来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《Casefile》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Weeks before the fire,
sentences.zh: 火灾发生前几周，

sentences.en: George Sodder was suddenly disrupted by the sound of knocking.
sentences.zh: 乔治·萨德突然被一阵敲门声打断了思绪。

sentences.en: It was coming from the front door.
sentences.zh: 声音是从前门传来的。

sentences.en: At his doorstep was a young man he didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 门口站着一个他从未见过的年轻人。

sentences.en: The stranger asked if there was any work going at George's coal trucking business.
sentences.zh: 这个陌生人问乔治的煤炭运输生意是否还招人。

sentences.en: George regretfully told him no.
sentences.zh: 乔治遗憾地告诉他没有。

sentences.en: Instead of leaving, the man meandered towards the rear of the Sodder's farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 那人没有离开，而是慢悠悠地朝萨德家农舍的后方走去。

sentences.en: George followed close behind, keeping an eye on him.
sentences.zh: 乔治紧随其后，一直盯着他。

sentences.en: The man then stopped where the building's two fuse boxes were located.
sentences.zh: 那人随后停在了房子两个保险丝盒所在的位置。

sentences.en: George had just had new wiring installed to fit an electric stove for his family.
sentences.zh: 乔治刚为家人安装了新的线路，以便使用电炉。

sentences.en: The local power company had recently given the set-up the once-over, telling him the wiring was installed correctly and functioning properly.
sentences.zh: 当地电力公司最近刚检查过这套装置，告诉他线路安装正确，运行正常。

sentences.en: The man turned to George and said,
sentences.zh: 那人转向乔治说道：

sentences.en: This is going to cause a fire one day.
sentences.zh: 这迟早会引起火灾的。

sentences.en: Without offering any further explanation, the stranger went on his way.
sentences.zh: 没再多做解释，这个陌生人就离开了。

sentences.en: In retrospect,
sentences.zh: 回想起来，

sentences.en: George considered this unknown man could be the arsonist, seeking revenge for not being given work.
sentences.zh: 乔治认为这个陌生人可能是纵火犯，因为没得到工作而寻求报复。

sentences.en: But this was not the only strange encounter at the Sodder's house prior to the fire.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是火灾前萨德家发生的唯一一件怪事。

sentences.en: A short time after this incident, another man showed up on the Sodder doorstep named Armstead Rosser Long Jr.
sentences.zh: 这件事发生后不久，另一个名叫阿姆斯特德·罗瑟·朗二世的男人出现在萨德家的门口。
zh_words: 阿姆斯特德·罗瑟·朗二世

sentences.en: He was trying to sell family life insurance.
sentences.zh: 他试图推销家庭人寿保险。

sentences.en: When George declined to take out a policy,
sentences.zh: 当乔治拒绝购买保险时，

sentences.en: Long Jr.
sentences.zh: 朗二世

sentences.en: became furious, yelling at George,
sentences.zh: 变得暴跳如雷，冲着乔治大喊：

sentences.en: Your goddamn house is going up in smoke and your children are going to be destroyed.
sentences.zh: 你那该死的房子会化为灰烬，你的孩子们也会死无葬身之地。

sentences.en: You are going to pay for the dirty remarks you have been making about Mussolini.
sentences.zh: 你会为你一直以来对墨索里尼发表的那些肮脏言论付出代价的。

sentences.en: This comment took George by surprise,
sentences.zh: 这番话让乔治大吃一惊，

sentences.en: Although Mussolini was admired by some,
sentences.zh: 尽管有些人崇拜墨索里尼，

sentences.en: George Sodder went out of his way to make known his view that he despised the former dictator, who had been executed nine months before the fire.
sentences.zh: 但乔治·萨德特意表明过自己的观点，他鄙视这位在前一年火灾发生前九个月就被处决的前独裁者。

sentences.en: It was a subject that divided his neighbours, and George was sure it made him some local enemies.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让邻居们产生分歧的话题，乔治确信这让他树立了一些当地的敌人。

sentences.en: Armstead Rosser Long Jr., the man who had threatened George, later served on the coroner's jury who determined the cause of the fire to be faulty wiring.
sentences.zh: 曾威胁过乔治的阿姆斯特德·罗瑟·朗二世，后来担任了验尸官陪审团成员，该陪审团裁定火灾原因是线路故障。
zh_words: 阿姆斯特德·罗瑟·朗二世

sentences.en: He was never investigated as a suspect, nor was his appearance on the jury with two of his close acquaintances regarded as a conflict of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 他从未被作为嫌疑人调查过，他与两名熟人一同出现在陪审团中也未被视为利益冲突。

sentences.en: In addition, in the weeks prior to Christmas, as the school-aged children finished up for the year, they approached George and Jenny with a concern.
sentences.zh: 此外，在圣诞节前的几周里，当学龄孩子们结束了一年的学业时，他们向乔治和珍妮表达了一个担忧。

sentences.en: They had seen a man watching them intently from his car that was pulled up alongside the highway as they got off the school bus and walked to their home.
sentences.zh: 他们看到一个男人从停在公路旁的车里一直盯着他们看，当时他们刚下校车，正走回家。

sentences.en: Initially dismissing their children, the Sodders now wondered if this had anything to do with the fire.
sentences.zh: 萨德夫妇起初没把孩子们的话当回事，现在却怀疑这是否与火灾有关。

sentences.en: One issue that lingered in the minds of the Sodder parents was the lack of human remains uncovered in the aftermath of the fire.
sentences.zh: 萨德夫妇心中挥之不去的一个问题是，火灾后现场没有发现人类遗骸。

sentences.en: One day,
sentences.zh: 有一天，

sentences.en: Jenny Sodder was reading a newspaper when she came across an article detailing the deaths of a local family of seven in a house fire.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·萨德正在看报纸，偶然发现了一篇报道，详细描述了当地一户七口之家在火灾中丧生的新闻。

sentences.en: All skeletons had been recovered, including that of a three-month-old baby.
sentences.zh: 所有的遗骸都被找回了，包括一个三个月大的婴儿。

sentences.en: According to the Sunday Gazette Mail,
sentences.zh: 据《星期日公报邮报》报道，

sentences.en: Jenny Sodder began to experiment.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·萨德开始进行实验。

sentences.en: She wanted to see if a fire could completely disintegrate bones as she had been told by the fire chief following her own tragedy.
sentences.zh: 她想看看火是否真的能像火灾调查负责人告诉她的那样，将骨头完全烧毁。

sentences.en: Jenny took leftovers from dinner, chicken bones, pork chop bones and beef joints, and placed them in a wood-burning stove to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 珍妮拿了晚餐剩下的鸡骨头、猪排骨和牛关节，把它们放进木柴炉里，看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: After each time, she was left with a pile of burnt, but still visibly intact, bones.
sentences.zh: 每次实验后，她都会剩下一堆烧焦但仍清晰可见的骨头。

sentences.en: Jenny visited a crematorium to discuss her findings.
sentences.zh: 珍妮去了一家火葬场讨论她的发现。

sentences.en: An employee told her that even after burning a human body for two hours at 2,000 degrees, skeletal remains were still present.
sentences.zh: 一名员工告诉她，即使在2000度的高温下焚烧人体两小时，骨骼遗骸依然会存在。

sentences.en: The fire that consumed the Sodder household did not reach nearly as high a temperature or burn intensely for as long.
sentences.zh: 吞噬萨德家的那场火灾温度远没有那么高，燃烧时间也没有那么长。

sentences.en: It left a major question for the Sodders.
sentences.zh: 这给萨德夫妇留下了一个巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: If the children were in the fire,
sentences.zh: 如果孩子们在火灾中，

sentences.en: then where were their remains?
sentences.zh: 那么他们的遗骸在哪里？

sentences.en: Fifty miles north of Fayetteville, in the town of Charleston, a woman was reading the local newspaper when she saw an article detailing the fire that killed the Sodder children.
sentences.zh: 在费耶特维尔以北50英里的查尔斯顿镇，一位妇女在读当地报纸时，看到了一篇关于萨德家孩子在火灾中丧生的报道。

sentences.en: Accompanying the piece were the photographs of the five deceased children.
sentences.zh: 文章配有五名遇难孩子的照片。

sentences.en: The woman recognised four of the five children immediately, having seen them at the hotel where she worked a week after the fire.
sentences.zh: 这位妇女立刻认出了其中四个孩子，因为火灾发生一周后，她在工作的酒店见过他们。

sentences.en: She contacted authorities and signed an affidavit, which read,
sentences.zh: 她联系了当局并签署了一份宣誓书，上面写道：

sentences.en: The children were accompanied by two women and two men, all of Italian extraction.
sentences.zh: 孩子们由两名妇女和两名男子陪同，他们都是意大利裔。

sentences.en: I do not remember the exact date.
sentences.zh: 我不记得确切日期了。

sentences.en: However, the entire party did register at the hotel and stayed in a large room with several beds.
sentences.zh: 但他们一行人确实在酒店登记入住，并住进了一个有几张床的大房间。

sentences.en: They registered about midnight.
sentences.zh: 他们大约在午夜登记入住。

sentences.en: I tried to talk to the children in a friendly manner, but the men appeared hostile and refused to allow me to talk to these children.
sentences.zh: 我试图友好地与孩子们交谈，但那些男人显得很敌视，拒绝让我和孩子们说话。

sentences.en: One of the men looked at me in a hostile manner.
sentences.zh: 其中一个男人以敌对的目光看着我。

sentences.en: He turned around and began talking rapidly in Italian.
sentences.zh: 他转过身，开始快速地用意大利语交谈。

sentences.en: Immediately, the whole party stopped talking to me.
sentences.zh: 整个一行人立刻停止了与我的交谈。

sentences.en: I sensed that I was being frozen out and so I said nothing more.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到自己被排斥了，所以没再说什么。

sentences.en: They left early the next morning.
sentences.zh: 他们第二天一早便离开了。

sentences.en: This was not the only alleged sighting that made its way back to George and Jenny Sodder.
sentences.zh: 这并不是唯一传回乔治和珍妮·萨德耳中的所谓目击事件。

sentences.en: Another woman came forward to say she served the children breakfast at a tourist stop outside of Fayetteville on the morning of the fire.
sentences.zh: 另一位妇女站出来说，火灾当天早上，她在费耶特维尔外的一个旅游站为孩子们提供了早餐。

sentences.en: She also noticed a car with Florida license plates parked outside.
sentences.zh: 她还注意到外面停着一辆挂着佛罗里达州车牌的汽车。

sentences.en: This coincided with a later sighting in the commercial fishing village of Cortez, Florida.
sentences.zh: 这与后来在佛罗里达州科尔特斯商业渔村的目击事件相吻合。

sentences.en: The local police followed up the leads, but they didn't get far.
sentences.zh: 当地警方跟进了这些线索，但没有取得多大进展。

sentences.en: the Sodders, certain that their children had been kidnapped and a fire lit to cover the tracks, wrote to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 萨德夫妇确信他们的孩子是被绑架的，火灾是为了掩盖踪迹，于是写信给联邦调查局。

sentences.en: They received a reply from Director J.
sentences.zh: 他们收到了局长J·埃德加·胡佛的回复。

sentences.en: Edgar Hoover.
sentences.zh: 在信中，他告诉萨德夫妇他很想提供帮助，但这似乎属于地方事务，不在联邦调查局的管辖范围内。

sentences.en: In the letter, he told the Sodders he would like to be of assistance, but it seemed like a local matter not within the jurisdiction of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果能获得费耶特维尔警察局和消防局的调查许可，他们同意提供协助。

sentences.en: However, they agreed to help if permission to investigate was received from the Fayetteville police and fire departments.
sentences.zh: 由于未知原因，警察局和消防局拒绝配合。

sentences.en: For reasons unknown, the police and fire departments refused to cooperate.
sentences.zh: 乔治·萨德追踪了关于他孩子们的所谓目击线索，前往据称发现他们的各个地点，

sentences.en: George Sodder followed up the alleged sightings of his children, travelling to the various locations where they were reportedly spotted,
sentences.zh: 但每次回家时，他离找到他们依然遥遥无期。

sentences.en: but he returned home each time no closer to finding them.
sentences.zh: 1949年，在当地报纸上看到一张学童的照片后，他前往纽约曼哈顿。

sentences.en: In 1949, he travelled to Manhattan in New York City after seeing a photograph of some schoolchildren in the local newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他确信其中一个是失踪的女儿，

sentences.en: He became convinced that one of them was his missing daughter,
sentences.zh: 贝蒂。

sentences.en: Betty.
sentences.zh: 乔治找到了那家人，但他们拒绝与他交谈。

sentences.en: George tracked down the family, but they refused to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 为了帮助追查线索，

sentences.en: In order to help chase up Leeds,
sentences.zh: 乔治聘请了私家侦探

sentences.en: George hired private investigator
sentences.zh: C.C.·廷斯利。

sentences.en: C.C.
sentences.zh: 廷斯利采访了费耶特维尔社区的成员。

sentences.en: Tinsley.
sentences.zh: 在与一位当地牧师交谈时，一个奇怪的故事浮出水面。

sentences.en: Tinsley interviewed members of the Fayetteville community.
sentences.zh: 牧师报告说，在圣诞节早晨调查萨德家废墟的消防队长F.J.·莫里斯曾带着忏悔来找过他。

sentences.en: Upon speaking with a local minister, a strange story emerged.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯说，那天早上他在灰烬中发现了人类心脏的残骸。

sentences.en: The minister reported that the fire chief,
sentences.zh: 但他没有通知任何人，而是拿走了心脏，把它放进一个盒子里，埋在了萨德家旧址的瓦砾下。

sentences.en: F.J.
sentences.zh: C.C.·廷斯利与消防队长对质，后者承认埋了那个盒子。

sentences.en: Morris, who investigated the ruins of the Sodder house on Christmas morning, had visited him with a confession.
sentences.zh: 他们一起去了现场，挖掘了一番，直到找到了它。

sentences.en: Morris said he had found the remains of a human heart in the ashes that morning.
sentences.zh: 廷斯利把盒子及其内容物送给了一位殡葬承办人。

sentences.en: But, instead of notifying anyone, he took the heart, placed it inside a box, and buried it underneath the rubble of the former Sodder house.
sentences.zh: 他检查了样本，并写了一封信向乔治·萨德总结了他的发现。

sentences.en: C.C.
sentences.zh: 那不是人类心脏，而是一块牛肝。

sentences.en: Tinsley confronted the fire chief, who admitted burying the box.
sentences.zh: 它甚至根本没有经过火烧。

sentences.en: Together, they went to the scene and dug around until they located it.
sentences.zh: 这些发现给案件增添了更多困惑。

sentences.en: Tinsley sent the box and its contents to a mortician.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·萨德透露，家里并没有吃过牛肝，火灾当晚家里也没有牛肝。

sentences.en: He examined the specimen and sent a letter summarising his findings to George Sodder.
sentences.zh: 廷斯利回到消防队长F.J.·莫里斯那里，告诉了他这些发现。

sentences.en: It wasn't a human heart, but a piece of beef liver.
sentences.zh: 他承认埋下牛肝是希望它被发现后，能平息萨德一家关于孩子们可能还活着的担忧。

sentences.en: It hadn't even been in a fire.
sentences.zh: 当这一怪异行为的消息传开后，其他人猜测他埋下器官是为了阻止调查。

sentences.zh: 或者当地黑手党曾试图招募乔治，但他拒绝了，从而促使他们寻求报复。

sentences.en: According to the Smithsonian magazine, another theory was that the five missing Sodder children had been kidnapped by someone they knew, who told them of the fire and offered
sentences.zh: 据《史密森尼》杂志报道，另一种理论是，这五个失踪的萨德孩子是被他们认识的人绑架的，那个人告诉他们火灾的事，并提出

sentences.en: to take them somewhere safe.
sentences.zh: 带他们去安全的地方。

sentences.en: They speculated that perhaps they were alive and had not contacted their siblings in order to protect them.
sentences.zh: 他们推测，也许他们还活着，只是为了保护兄弟姐妹而没有联系他们。

sentences.en: Sylvia Sodder, the youngest surviving
sentences.zh: 西尔维娅·萨德，萨德家最小的幸存

sentences.en: Sodder child, is now in her late seventies.
sentences.zh: 孩子，现在已经七十多岁了。

sentences.en: She is the only known Sodder child still alive.
sentences.zh: 她是目前已知的唯一在世的萨德孩子。

sentences.en: According to Medium.com, Sylvia is certain that her siblings did not perish in the fire.
sentences.zh: 据 Medium.com 报道，西尔维娅确信她的兄弟姐妹并没有在火灾中丧生。

sentences.en: She still browses online blogs dedicated to finding out what happened to her family, in the hope of getting some answers before she passes.
sentences.zh: 她仍然会浏览那些致力于查明她家人遭遇的在线博客，希望能在他去世前得到一些答案。

sentences.en: Although Sylvia was only three at the time of the fire, she can still remember her father's bleeding arm.
sentences.zh: 尽管火灾时西尔维娅只有三岁，但她仍记得父亲流血的手臂。

sentences.en: She has also never forgotten the screams of those who escaped the inferno, watching helplessly as it destroyed their lives forever.
sentences.zh: 她也从未忘记那些从地狱中逃出来的人的尖叫声，无助地看着火灾永远摧毁了他们的生活。

sentences.en: One event that came the closest to solving the mystery of what happened to the Sodder children occurred in August 1949, nearly four years after the fire.
sentences.zh: 最接近解开萨德孩子失踪之谜的一件事发生在 1949 年 8 月，即火灾发生近四年后。

sentences.en: In desperation to find any evidence that would prove to him that his children perished in the blaze,
sentences.zh: 为了找到任何能向他证明孩子们在火灾中丧生的证据，

sentences.en: George Sodder hired a small crew and excavated the site he had previously filled over with dirt.
sentences.zh: 乔治·萨德雇了一个小团队，挖掘了他之前填平的遗址。

sentences.en: Watching as George removed the soil with a bulldozer was a Washington DC pathologist named Oscar B.
sentences.zh: 看着乔治用推土机清理泥土的是一位名叫奥斯卡·B·

sentences.en: Hunter, whom the Sodders had hired for his expert opinion.
sentences.zh: 亨特的华盛顿特区病理学家，萨德夫妇聘请他是为了获得他的专家意见。

sentences.en: As printed in the Raleigh Register, he told George that had the children perished in the fire, he expected their skulls would be located.
sentences.zh: 正如《罗利纪事报》所刊登的那样，他告诉乔治，如果孩子们在火灾中丧生，他预计会找到他们的头骨。

sentences.en: No Fayetteville county officials attended the scene, aside from a deputy sheriff, who watched on and didn't participate.
sentences.zh: 除了一个在旁观看且未参与的副警长外，没有费耶特县的官员到场。

sentences.en: Excavating to a depth of five feet, the crew combed through the dirt and rubble to find human remains.
sentences.zh: 挖掘深度达到五英尺，团队在泥土和瓦砾中搜寻人类遗骸。

sentences.en: They found several coins that had been burnt but were still recognisable, a damaged dictionary, bits of roofing, and other small objects that had not been impacted by the blaze.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了几枚被烧过但仍可辨认的硬币、一本损坏的字典、一些屋顶碎片以及其他未受火灾影响的小物件。

sentences.en: Then, they uncovered some bones.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们发现了一些骨头。

sentences.en: The skeletal remains, which appeared to be vertebrae, were sent to the
sentences.zh: 这些看起来像是脊椎骨的骨骼遗骸被送往

sentences.en: Smithsonian Institute for analysis.
sentences.zh: 史密森尼学会进行分析。

sentences.en: The report, which was sent to the Sodders, concluded,
sentences.zh: 发给萨德夫妇的报告结论是：

sentences.en: The human bones consist of four lumbar vertebrae belonging to one individual.
sentences.zh: 这些人类骨骼由属于同一个体的四块腰椎组成。

sentences.en: Since the transverse recesses are fused, the age of this individual at death should have been 16 or 17 years.
sentences.zh: 由于横突凹陷已经融合，该个体死亡时的年龄应为 16 或 17 岁。

sentences.en: The top limit of age should be about 22, since the centra, which normally fuse at 23, are still unfused.
sentences.zh: 年龄上限应约为 22 岁，因为通常在 23 岁融合的椎体中心尚未融合。

sentences.en: The oldest Sodder child determined to have perished in the fire was 14-year-old Morris.
sentences.zh: 在火灾中被认定丧生的萨德孩子中，年龄最大的是 14 岁的莫里斯。

sentences.en: The report continued,
sentences.zh: 报告继续写道：

sentences.en: On this basis, the bones show greater skeletal maturation than one would expect for a 14-year-old boy.
sentences.zh: 基于此，这些骨骼显示的骨骼成熟度比 14 岁男孩预期的要高。

sentences.en: The vertebrae showed no evidence that they had been exposed to fire, and it is very strange that no other bones were found in the allegedly careful
sentences.zh: 这些脊椎骨没有显示出曾暴露在火中的迹象，而且在据称仔细

sentences.en: excavation of the basement of the house.
sentences.zh: 挖掘房屋地下室的过程中没有发现其他骨头，这非常奇怪。

sentences.en: One would expect to find the full skeletons of the five children, rather than only four vertebrae.
sentences.zh: 人们本应期望找到五个孩子的完整骨架，而不是只有四块脊椎骨。

sentences.en: This was a sentiment echoed by many professionals who were called upon to give their opinion over the years following the fire.
sentences.zh: 火灾发生后的几年里，许多被要求发表意见的专业人士也表达了同样的看法。

sentences.en: In a 15-year anniversary article printed in the Beckley Post Herald on Christmas Day 1960, a pathologist said, I wouldn't say it's impossible, but it's highly improbable.
sentences.zh: 在 1960 年圣诞节刊登于《贝克利邮报先驱报》的 15 周年纪念文章中，一位病理学家说：我不会说这是不可能的，但可能性极低。

sentences.en: I have seen about 120 burning deaths, and there were always some remains left.
sentences.zh: 我见过大约 120 起火灾死亡案例，总会留下一些遗骸。

sentences.en: Another pathologist who wished to remain anonymous was quoted as saying,
sentences.zh: 另一位希望保持匿名的病理学家被引用说：

sentences.en: No ordinary house fire could completely consume five bodies.
sentences.zh: 没有任何普通的房屋火灾能完全烧毁五具尸体。

sentences.en: The findings prompted two hearings about the Sodder case in the West Virginian capital of Charleston.
sentences.zh: 这些发现促使西弗吉尼亚州首府查尔斯顿举行了两次关于萨德案的听证会。

sentences.en: However, the governor and state police superintendent closed the case due to lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，州长和州警察局长因证据不足结案了。

sentences.en: The vertebrae were not returned to the Sodders, and the report concluded that the bones likely came from the dirt that George Sodder used to cover over the rubble of the fire.
sentences.zh: 这些脊椎骨没有归还给萨德夫妇，报告结论称这些骨头很可能来自乔治·萨德用来覆盖火灾瓦砾的泥土。

sentences.en: As the remains have long since disappeared, this raises another question that will forever be unanswered.
sentences.zh: 由于遗骸早已消失，这提出了另一个永远无法回答的问题。

sentences.en: If the bones weren't from the Sodder children, then who did they belong to?
sentences.zh: 如果这些骨头不是萨德孩子们的，那么它们属于谁？

sentences.en: When Jenny Sodder died in 1989, her remaining children took down the billboard she and George had erected in an effort to find out what exactly had happened to 14-year-old Morris,
sentences.zh: 1989 年珍妮·萨德去世时，她剩下的孩子们拆除了她和乔治竖起的广告牌，他们曾试图以此查明 14 岁的莫里斯、

sentences.en: 12-year-old Martha,
sentences.zh: 12 岁的玛莎、

sentences.en: 9-year-old Louis,
sentences.zh: 9 岁的刘易斯、

sentences.en: 8-year-old Jenny, and 5-year-old Betty.
sentences.zh: 8 岁的珍妮和 5 岁的贝蒂究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: It had read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: On Christmas Eve 1945, our home was set afire and five of our children, ages 5 through 14, kidnapped.
sentences.zh: 1945 年平安夜，我们的家被纵火，我们五个 5 到 14 岁的孩子被绑架了。

sentences.en: The officials blamed defective wiring, although lights were still burning after the fire started.
sentences.zh: 官员们归咎于线路故障，尽管火灾开始后灯依然亮着。

sentences.en: The official report stated that the children died in the fire.
sentences.zh: 官方报告称孩子们在火灾中丧生。

sentences.en: However, no bones were found in the residue and there was no smell of burning flesh during or after the fire.
sentences.zh: 然而，在残骸中没有发现骨头，火灾期间或之后也没有闻到烧焦的肉味。

sentences.en: What was the motive of the law officers involved?
sentences.zh: 涉案执法人员的动机是什么？

sentences.en: What did they have to gain by making us suffer all these years of injustice?
sentences.zh: 让他们遭受这么多年的不公，他们能从中得到什么？

sentences.en: Why did they lie and force us to accept those lies?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要撒谎并强迫我们接受这些谎言？
